note: Registry of marketing motion effects (ASR-039). Canvas, WebGL and rAF-loop code under the marketing roots ships only inside an effect listed here, with a reduced-motion rest state, a static fallback and a perf budget. Files ending in / are directory prefixes. Guide: .claude/skills/design-system/guides/motion.md. Checked by scripts/invariants/art-direction/surface-media.mjs. Every WebGL or canvas-loop background also registers in apps/web/data/marketing/animatedBackgroundBudget.ts (static by default, <= 2ms per frame).
